name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.foldl_exStep_zero
typeText:
∀ (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network Nat) (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Nat Nat)) (rls : List.{0} (List.{0} Nat))
  (y : Nat),
  Eq.{1}
    (List.foldl.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.exStep N U) (Prod.mk.{0, 0} 0 (Prod.mk.{0, 0} y List.nil.{0}))
          rls).2.2
    (List.reverse.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.extractR N U rls y))

source.code:
theorem foldl_exStep_zero (N : Network ℕ) (U : List (ℕ × ℕ)) :
    ∀ (rls : List (List ℕ)) (y : ℕ),
      (List.foldl (exStep N U) (0, y, []) rls).2.2 = (N.extractR U rls y).reverse
  | [], y => by simp [Network.extractR]
  | L :: rls, y => by
      simp only [List.foldl_cons, Network.extractR]
      by_cases hy : y ∈ L
      · rw [show exStep N U (0, y, []) L = (1, y, [y]) by simp [exStep, hy], if_pos hy,
          foldl_exStep_one N U rls y []]
        simp
      · rw [show exStep N U (0, y, []) L = (0, y, []) by simp [exStep, hy], if_neg hy]
        exact foldl_exStep_zero N U rls y
